parent_adjudication: Parent confirmed by direct image read: suppressive-drive is a single merged bright blob (no two gap-separated bands); attention-field peak is near-center, not over the right stimulus. VLM FAIL upheld. Figure 1 is BROKEN despite deterministic tests passing.

verdict.summary: The generated figure reproduces the overall pipeline schematic well: the stimulus cartoon (two vertical gratings, fixation dot, solid and dashed circles), the two equal narrow stripes in the stimulus drive, the orientation-flat grayscale attention field, and the asymmetric two-stripe output firing rate are all present and correct. However, several quantitative checklist items fail. The suppressive drive does not show two distinct bands with a clear dark gap - it appears as a single broad merged bright blob. The attention field peak is positioned near the horizontal center rather than in the middle of the right half, and the left half is not clearly midgray baseline.
